payload.symptoms: drug resistant mesial temporal lobe epilepsy with hippocampal sclerosis
payload.supporting_quote: mTLE patients presented increased frequency of CD4(+) T lymphocytes expressing IL-6 when compared to healthy volunteers.
Oxidative stress markers (glutathione, total antioxidant capacity, malondialdehyde), cytokines and glutamate were elevated in WDNM compared to controls.
